rationale: The eight references are immutable v1 candidates with explicit organizational payers and paid events, founder-compatible initial capital and time assumptions, and channel-led or embedded acquisition routes that can be tested without a public-facing founder brand. The commercial-archetype audit is deliberately varied: regulatory evidence operations SaaS (control10-01), commissioning assurance workflow (control10-07), supply-chain conformity data rail (control10-09), certified-network integration middleware (control10-12), forward asset-rights marketplace with evidence services (rights10-05), permissioned procurement evidence rail (rights10-08), regulated side-stream marketplace with forward contracts (rights10-09), and asset evidence and damage-settlement ledger (settle10-10). Their control points are likewise distinct: ZUM submission evidence release, machinery handover, packaging-spec approval, pre-dispatch eFTI payload generation, a pre-demolition reservation window, invoice-to-certificate allocation and retirement, recurring generator authorization tied to feed traceability, and serial-level inspection/custody history. Critical dependencies span programme and laboratory access, integrator adoption and qualified safety review, packaging guidance and converter participation, certified-platform access, safe removal and lawful fallback, registry-capable licensed counterparties, feed-lawful materials and operators, and consistent rental handoff capture; no single dependency dominates the shortlist. Delayed-history review excluded close-repeat families around BDO pickup/KPO workflows, F-gas and heat-pump service passports, battery-passport custody and battery resale, CRA and cyber-incident evidence, EUDAMED registration, EUDR and CBAM preparation, flexibility and charging-capacity origination, KSeF and generic invoice exceptions, solar and heat-pump warranty/performance evidence, and wastewater or sludge offtake. The selected ZUM concept changes the payer and gate to supplier-side subsidised-list release; the demolition concept controls an owner-authorized reservation before mixing rather than financing separated waste; and the former-food concept binds recurring feed-eligible supply rather than generic waste brokerage. Unverified demand, partner commitment, data access, event volume, liability allocation, and conservative unit economics remain research questions rather than exclusion grounds.
